name: STAC Open Science Extension Ontology
title: Definitions for STAC OSC extension elements
description: Vocabulary defining the elements of the STAC ESA Open Science Catalog (OSC) extension (osc:type, osc:status, osc:project, osc:region, osc:variables, osc:missions, osc:experiment, osc:workflows), providing Linked Data terms for the STAC OSC schema. osc:type and osc:status are modeled as skos:ConceptSchemes; the remaining free-text fields stay OWL. Replaces an earlier placeholder that incorrectly reused the STAC core ontology's namespace and described none of OSC's own elements.

examples.title: OSC product (matching the shape of stac-extensions/osc's product examples)
